Event Start
	Form.Caption = Format("GXSPC_SelectionList", "Trn Group Probe Base")
	&ADVANCED_LABEL_TEMPLATE = "%1 <strong>%2</strong>"
EndEvent

Event 'Toggle'
	if AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerVisible
		BtnToggle.Class += !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggleActive
	else
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		BtnToggle.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggle
	endif
Endevent

Event LblTrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilter.Click
	if TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cTrnGroupProbeBaseId.Visible = true
	else
		TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cTrnGroupProbeBaseId.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblGpBaseIdFilter.Click
	if GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cGpBaseId.Visible = true
	else
		GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cGpBaseId.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblGpBaseDescFilter.Click
	if GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cGpBaseDesc.Visible = true
	else
		GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cGpBaseDesc.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event Load
	&LinkSelection.FromImage(selectRow)
EndEvent

Event Enter
	&pTrnGroupProbeBaseId = TrnGroupProbeBaseId
	Return
EndEvent
